thread:
jin.kim: Heads up – noticed ~12 GPU nodes in eu-west with BMC NICs flapping after last night's BMC microcode push. Some nodes show secure-boot toggled to 'Enabled' even though the provisioning image expects 'Disabled'. Anyone else seeing this?
alex.m: saw same on 3 racks. Provisioner backlog spiked, autoscaler started thrashing. Dropping autoscaler burst for eu-west to stabilize.
maria: can you paste a quick log/snippet from one of the affected nodes?
jin.kim: here's `ipmitool lan print` from node-214 (sanitized):
```
root@node-214:~# ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.5.214 -U admin -P **** lan print
Set in progress         : Set Complete
IP Address              : 10.0.5.214
MAC Address             : 02:42:c0:a8:05:d6
Default Gateway IP      : 10.0.5.1
BMC NIC Mode            : Shared
UEFI Secure Boot Status : Enabled
```
sam: confirmed — BMC shows secure boot enabled. We normally manage efivars in the init ram before PXE; when this flips nodes drop to local boot and fail to provision, causing retries.
ops-bot: @channel Incident created: INC-2025-540 — "eu-west BMC microcode causing secureboot flips / provisioning failures". Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bmc-flash-rollback
alex.m: canary rollback to previous microcode on eu-west1? Runbook step 4 is manual but quick. We should avoid full fleet until canary looks OK.
maria: starting canary rollback on eu-west1-r3 (5 nodes). Rolling one rack at a time.
jin.kim: update: 2/5 in r3 rolled back, both returned to PXE and joined the provision pool. Backlog reduced ~40%.
sam: paused autoscaler burst and set max capacity to current so we don't spin up more broken nodes. Also routing new provisioning attempts to a dedicated spare pool in us-west until eu-west stabilizes.
deploy-bot: rollback job initiated by maria — job id rollback-1758880000-1. Tracking. ETA ~18m.
alex.m: if rollback fixes it, we still need to block that microcode build from the release pipeline and notify firmware vendor.
jin.kim: agreed. If rollback doesn't clear secureboot flips we should temporarily firewall BMC mgmt (oob-mgmt VLAN) to prevent further remote flashes while we investigate. Not ideal but quick containment.
ops-bot: INC-2025-540 status: Mitigating -> Canaries rolling -> 3 racks impacted, 2 racks recovered.
sam: good work. Keep updates terse. We'll follow up with a postmortem and cost impact (provisioning retries increased instance churn).
